media_confirmed_video.name: media_confirmed_video
media_confirmed_video.value: "media"."kind" != 'video' OR "media"."confirmed_at" IS NULL OR ("media"."video_version" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."duration_ms" BETWEEN 1 AND 600000 AND "media"."width" <= 4096 AND "media"."height" <= 4096)

training_exercises_template_slot.name: training_exercises_template_slot
training_exercises_template_slot.where: "training_session_exercises"."template_exercise_id" is not null and "training_session_exercises"."deleted_at" is null

training_sets_right.name: training_sets_right
training_sets_right.value: "training_session_sets"."right_amount" is null or ("training_session_sets"."unilateral" and "training_session_sets"."right_amount" between 0 and 600)

training_sets_weight.name: training_sets_weight
training_sets_weight.value: "training_session_sets"."weight_kg" is null or ("training_session_sets"."load" <> 'bodyweight' and "training_session_sets"."weight_kg" between 0 and 1000)

training_sessions_workout_day.name: training_sessions_workout_day
training_sessions_workout_day.where: "training_sessions"."workout_id" is not null and "training_sessions"."deleted_at" is null
